headline: Law fixes a technical error in the definitions section of the federal Controlled Substances Act.
what_it_does: This law makes a technical correction to the definitions section of the Controlled Substances Act, the main federal law on regulating drugs. The official summary does not say which definition was changed or describe any change in how the law works.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed into law on December 23, 2024; the summary does not give a separate effective date.
